verdict.rationale: Gmail's Gemini integration supports summarizing threads, organizing, and drafting (gmail-docs-13/14/23/33), which shows some AI-assisted grounded interaction with email content, but there's no evidence of cross-inbox Q&A ('who said what', 'what's outstanding') or any calendar integration/grounding. missing for 10: whole-inbox conversational Q&A, cross-thread synthesis beyond single-thread summarization, calendar-grounded answers, evidence of assistant answering questions spanning multiple emails/senders.
